title: Internal: how a member files a Club Membership cancellation notice
content:
## Scope
This document covers the tool by which a member gives their own notice of cancellation on a Club Membership contract.

## Situation of use and capability
This tool creates a new cancellation-request record naming the membership contract and the requested effective date, and moves the contract's own lifecycle status to a pending-cancellation state.

## How it is invoked
This tool belongs to the customer: it must first be unlocked and handed over, to be run by the customer themselves. The tool itself is named: file_cancellation_notice_df814962.

## Parameters
- membership_id: the reference number of the membership contract the member is cancelling, looked up from the member's membership holdings before the call.
- requested_effective_date: the calendar date the cancellation is to take effect, in YYYY-MM-DD format; always required.

## Return
A successful call returns a confirmation naming the new cancellation-request record's own reference number, and restating the membership contract and the requested effective date. If the membership contract does not exist on file, the same call reports that back in its return message rather than raising an error.

## Points of judgement
The customer themselves running file_cancellation_notice_df814962 a second time for the same membership contract creates a second, separate cancellation-request record; it does not correct or replace the first.
